info.title: Ark-IV API
info.description: Typed serving API for species and H3 cell details. Coarse map data uses Arrow/PMTiles and fine global cells use cached on-demand tiles. coverage_profile selects matching SQL and map artifacts. Score weights and threat/DNA products must be finite. Cell IDs must be valid H3 cells matching resolution; nonempty ecosystem filters must be canonical.
